name: Single Fin
notes: Own site (singlefinsd.com redirects to singlefinfeeds.com, same restaurant, Squarespace-hosted). Dinner and breakfast menu photos read visually, full resolution. Three breakfast items (Huevos Rancheros, Breakfast Biscuit Sandwich, Biscuits & Gravy) are struck through with a red line in the image itself (filename literally says 'crossed out') and were excluded as discontinued. The Cocktails menu image lists drink names/ingredients with NO prices anywhere on the page, so cocktails could not be recorded (omitted rather than guessed). The '$6 Menu' and Happy Hour images are time-limited specials/promos rather than the base menu and were left out except where noted. COMPLETE for food (breakfast + dinner); drinks are NOT priced on this site.

dishes.name: Baja Malibu
